config.fitting: hash folds2/3/4; stop fold1; refit folds1/2/3/4; calibrate fold0
config.calibration_proposal: cached native GRAM50, shared by every arm; transfer to SAS-guided proposal
config.input: BGE full-history recency mean plus last-item text vector
config.confidence: temperature-scaled posterior normalized entropy, not guaranteed reliability
config.score: per-user std-normalized generated score minus strength times bounded penalty

statistical_review.simpson: Domains and batches/blocks separate; no per-domain selected method.
statistical_review.ecological: Per-user gains/losses saved; no universal benefit.
statistical_review.collider: Targets never select candidate pools; outside targets retained.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: All intervals descriptive and unadjusted; selection grid fixed beforehand.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Attribute fields, split, head, grid and methods frozen before evaluation.
statistical_review.causation: Fixed-pool reranking only; calibration-proposal shift disclosed; no generation improvement claim.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: Training-side target attributes are supervision only; evaluation targets used for diagnostics/metrics.
